name: Picsart Creative APIs MCP
description: Lets coding agents call Picsart Creative APIs over MCP to remove backgrounds, upscale, enhance, and generate images, and to write integration code from the API docs.

skills.name: Image Editing
skills.description: Removes or changes backgrounds, upscales, enhances faces, and applies effects to images, one tool per API action.

skills.name: Generative Images
skills.description: Generates images, stickers, and logos from text and inpaints, outpaints, or expands existing images.

skills.name: API Docs And Code Snippets
skills.description: Searches the Creative APIs specs, inspects endpoints and schemas, and returns code snippets for an integration.

skills.name: Credits Balance
skills.description: Checks the remaining Picsart API credit balance to confirm the key works before running jobs.
